run_record.event_definition: per-channel binary onset: current numeric value > 0 and immediately prior numeric value is missing or <= 0; first row is not an event

folds.participant_held_out: one fold per player_id; all sessions for player held out
folds.game_held_out: one fold per game; all sessions for game held out

run_record.future_input_policy: current and past telemetry; current/past proxy only for AR; held-out future proxy used only as outcome
run_record.training_policy: training-part median only; no fitted dynamics parameters; no alpha/beta/b/W
